home.headline: Study by IB syllabus code, then jump back to the moment that explains it.
home.lede: Every study page pairs the video with its key moments, a method checklist, exam wording, common traps, an interactive visual and practice questions.
home.pilot: Rows are IB syllabus codes. Red rows have no video; amber rows are mentioned only briefly in a video. One study page is live so far: Domain & Range, Composite, Inverse (AHL 2.7). Every other video is listed with its transcript only. Three syllabus-code pages are in pilot: SL 4.4, SL 4.10 and AHL 4.13 (click the code title).

calculator.examNote: Use your approved GDC (Casio fx-CG50 in class). Show the GDC result in your working.

frqNote: Practice box for typed written responses. Typing shortcuts: x-bar, mu, sigma, sqrt(), x^2, >=, <=. Show your working, state the GDC result, and give the final answer to 3 significant figures unless the question says otherwise.
